name: Vercel Eve
description: Filesystem-first agent framework by Vercel: an agent/ directory is the agent.
descriptionZh: Vercel 的文件系统式 Agent 框架：agent/ 目录即一个 Agent。
keyFact: Vercel Eve is an Apache-2.0, filesystem-first agent framework released in June 2026, in which an agent/ directory (instructions.md, tools/, skills/, channels/) defines the agent itself.
keyFactZh: Vercel Eve 是 2026 年 6 月发布的 Apache-2.0、文件系统式 Agent 框架：一个 agent/ 目录（instructions.md、tools/、skills/、channels/）本身就定义了一个 Agent。
caveat: Public beta at time of verification; small ecosystem and low star count. Maturity should not be assumed.
caveatZh: 核验时仍处 public beta；生态较新、星标量级小，不宜假定其成熟度。
